definition.en: Import and export controls are regulatory measures implemented by the government to manage the flow of goods and services across national borders to protect domestic industries and national security.
definition.hi: Import and export controls are regulatory measures implemented by the government to manage the flow of goods and services across national borders to protect domestic industries and national security.

importanceInUpsc.en: This topic is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it relates to trade policy, balance of payments, and industrial protectionism. Understanding these controls helps aspirants analyze how India manages its external sector and responds to global economic shifts.
importanceInUpsc.hi: This topic is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it relates to trade policy, balance of payments, and industrial protectionism. Understanding these controls helps aspirants analyze how India manages its external sector and responds to global economic shifts.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the rationale behind trade restrictions and liberalization.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the rationale behind trade restrictions and liberalization.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of import/export controls on the Indian economy.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the impact of import/export controls on the Indian economy.
